title: Research
text:
PPR Pond Mapper
In this project, I use remote sensing, machine learning, and open science practices to map terrestrial wetlands in the Great Plains region at a high level of detail. This work is funded by the USFWS and NASA, in an effort to better inform waterfowl conservation. Learn more about it here. 




Example of model performance: estimated surface water (blue) compared to observed surface water delineations (white).

Ponded water (blue) over satellite imagery of the plot, across the 2022-2025 growing seasons, compared side by side by time of year. Drag the slider or press play to step through each ~2-week period.

title: Maggie Church
text: Hi! My name is Maggie Church. I am a Ph.D. candidate in the Landscape Modeling lab, led by Dr. Jessica O’Connell. My work focuses on applying remote sensing to better understand wetland dynamics at regional scales. Previously, I spent 4 years as a data analyst, and hiked the Appalachian and Pacific Crest Trails.
